checks.ref:
command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
if [ -e "openspec/changes/$change" ]; then
  echo "openspec/changes/$change still exists - the change is not archived yet"
  exit 1
fi
base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD)
targets=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } \
  | grep -E "^openspec/changes/archive/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$change/proposal\.md$" \
  | sort -u | sed 's|/proposal\.md$||')
count=$(printf '%s' "$targets" | grep -c . || true)
if [ "$count" != 1 ]; then
  echo "expected exactly one new openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-$change/ holding the change's proposal.md, found $count:"
  echo "$targets"
  exit 1
fi
name=${targets##*/}
ym=$(printf '%s' "$targets" | cut -d/ -f4-5)
if [ "$ym" != "$(printf '%s' "$name" | cut -c1-4)/$(printf '%s' "$name" | cut -c6-7)" ]; then
  echo "$targets: the year/month directories must come from the date prefix (.claude/rules/archive-path.md)"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f "$targets/tasks.md" ] && grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' "$targets/tasks.md"; then
  echo "the archived change has unticked tasks (above) - an incomplete change is escalated, never archived"
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "^Archived to: $targets/\?$" "$dir/archive.md" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$dir/archive.md must carry the line 'Archived to: $targets/' - see .gnomish/stages/archive/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:if ! out=$(openspec validate --specs --strict --no-interactive 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^\s*ℹ' | tail -30
  echo "openspec validate --specs --strict must pass - the merge left a main spec invalid; fix the merge, never the delta"
  exit 1
fi

command:if ! out=$(./gradlew -q checkSpecContract 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -40
  echo "the spec-contract check failed over the merged specs (file:line, rule and fix above; the whole list is build/reports/spec-contract.txt) - read .claude/rules/traceability.md, .claude/rules/delta-specs.md and .claude/rules/testing.md; a merge that lost or rewrote a line is fixed in the merge, never the delta - anything else escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | sed 's/.* -> //')
stray=$(printf '%s\n' "$dirty" | grep -v '^$' \
  | grep -vxF "$dir/archive.md" \
  | grep -v "^openspec/changes/$change/" \
  | grep -vE "^openspec/changes/archive/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$change/" \
  | grep -v '^openspec/specs/' \
  | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$stray" ]; then
  echo "this stage moves openspec/changes/$change/, edits openspec/specs/ and writes $dir/archive.md, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$stray"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else; if you did not, leave them exactly as they are and escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE naming the paths."
  exit 1
fi
archived=$(ls -d openspec/changes/archive/*/*/????-??-??-"$change" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
for spec in $(printf '%s\n' "$dirty" | grep '^openspec/specs/.*/spec\.md$' || true); do
  capability=${spec#openspec/specs/}
  if [ ! -f "$archived/specs/$capability" ]; then
    echo "$spec changed, but the change has no delta spec for it ($archived/specs/$capability) - the merge touches only the capabilities the change carries deltas for"
    exit 1
  fi
done
